title: VulnerabilityHypothesis
description: Knowdit-style three-state spec + ReX class-level invariant binding. One file per candidate hypothesis. Persisted to disk so LLM context per call stays scoped.

id.description: Stable slug, e.g. 'rentry-vault-deposit-001'. Used as test name and filename.

mode.description: Controls duplicate handling and severity assumptions. Immunefi-style mode fails likely-static-duplicate findings.

forge_root.description: Optional Foundry project root. Defaults to repository poc-forge/.

project_dir.description: Original audited source root used for duplicate/static-analysis queries.

poc_path.description: Optional path to AttackHarness_<id>.t.sol. Relative paths are resolved from forge_root first, then repo root.

initial_state.description: Knowdit InitialState — translated to Foundry setUp(). Concrete addresses, balances, deployments.

pre_vuln_state.description: Conditions that must hold before exploit step runs. Translated to require() in attack flow.

post_vuln_state.description: Expected state after exploit. Class-level invariant (ReX style) is preferred over per-contract spec.

class_invariant.description: ReX-style class-level invariant tag — chooses universal oracle from invariants/ library

custom_assertion.description: Used only when class_invariant=invariant_violated_custom. Raw Solidity expression for assertTrue/assertGt.

min_profit_wei.description: Legacy threshold for econ-check gate. Prefer profit_min_raw for ERC20 or non-native assets.

profit_min_raw.description: Minimum actual invariant delta in raw asset units. verify.py compares this against emitted InvariantEvidence.delta.

profit_asset.description: ETH, NATIVE, or token address/symbol for the profit/loss asset.

profit_token_decimals.description: Decimals for ERC20 profit_asset when profit_token_price_wei is supplied.

profit_token_price_wei.description: Optional token price in wei per whole token. Enables gas-vs-profit comparison for ERC20 deltas.

property_function.description: Name of check_*() function in test contract for Halmos to verify

attack_steps.description: High-level steps; LLM expands each to Solidity in PoC drafting stage.

preconditions.description: External assumptions: 'attacker has 10 ETH', 'oracle reports stale price', etc.

rationale.description: Short explanation tying code path, exploitability, impact, and any KG seed together.

drop_reason.description: Set when this hypothesis is dropped — fed back into next iteration
